I will do this plot much like last season. I keep my own seed, and because money is tight I will not chase many things from town unless I have seen them work well on nearby farms. I will carry manure to this plot and put only a small amount of chemical fertilizer if I can get one bag to share, because this is my own land and I want the millet to stand better. I farm by rain, so I will not irrigate, and I will use family hands for most of the work.
